mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts indicate strengthening consumer demand and construction activity, which typically precedes positive equity returns as corporate earnings benefit from a robust economy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 60% of instances when HOUST rises.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants adjust to higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in industrial production indicates a strengthening labor market and manufacturing sector, which together drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as corporate profits expand.
failure_condition: The joint movement of UNRATE falling and INDPRO rising does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a high ratio of residential sales and finance (RSAFS) to real GDP (GDPC1) indicates excessive consumer leverage, which typically precedes a market correction and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, the ratio RSAFS/GDPC1 > 0.05 does not lead to negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5% for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production indicates expanding manufacturing output, which typically correlates with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals persistent inflationary pressures and a restrictive monetary policy, which together lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as real rates rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: The joint condition of CPIAUCSL rising and FEDFUNDS stable or rising does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1900 thousand units, it signals a weakening residential sector, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence and spending decline.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1900.
